model.none: No models. Add a connection or type a model ID in settings.

empty.setupTitle: Connect a model to get started
empty.setupBody: Add an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or any OpenAI-compatible service. Keys stay on this device.
empty.title: How can I help with this page?
empty.tip: Type / for commands, @ to attach the page or your selection.

act.title: What should I do on the web?
act.body: I'll work in the current tab: click, type, scroll and navigate. Risky steps wait for your approval.

examples.plans: Find the Rogers mobile plans under $60/month and compare them in a table
examples.compare: Search Amazon and AliExpress for a 65W USB-C charger and compare price and delivery
examples.process: Find out how to transfer my phone number to Rogers, step by step

composer.placeholderNoModel: Add a model in settings to start chatting
composer.defaultPrompt: Please look at the attached content.
composer.placeholderAct: Describe a task to do on the web…

modes.askHint: Chat about pages; nothing on the page is changed
modes.actHint: Let the agent operate the browser for you

context.needsAccess: Click to allow reading this site
context.includeHint: Attach this page to your next message
context.accessDenied: Access to this site wasn't granted, so the page can't be attached.
context.noSelection: No text is selected on the page.
context.captureFailed: Couldn't read this page. Reload it and try again.

summarize.label: Summarize
summarize.prompt: Summarize the key points of this page.

translate.label: Translate
translate.prompt: Translate the attached content into {{language}}. If it is already in {{language}}, translate it into English.

explain.label: Explain
explain.description: The selected text, in plain words
explain.prompt: Explain the selected text in plain words.

extractTables.label: Extract tables
extractTables.prompt: Extract the structured data on this page (prices, plans, specs, lists) as Markdown tables.

errors.auth: The API key was rejected. Check it in settings.
errors.forbidden: Access denied by the provider (403). Check the key's permissions or region.
errors.notFound: Not found (404). Check the base URL and model ID.
errors.rateLimit: Rate limit or quota reached. Wait a moment or check your balance.
errors.server: The provider had a server error ({{status}}). Try again later.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your network, the base URL, and site access.
errors.noModel: No model is selected. Choose one in settings.
errors.noKey: This connection has no API key. Add one in settings.

connections.title: Model providers
connections.description: Add a connection once per provider. Keys are stored only on this device and are sent only to the provider you configure.
connections.confirmDelete: Delete the connection “{{name}}”? Its API key will be removed from this device.
connections.noModelList: No model list. Type model IDs under Model roles.
connections.keyHint: Tip: create a separate key with a spending limit for this extension.
connections.keyKeep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it
connections.noModelsEndpoint: This service may not offer a model list. You can still save it and type a model ID under Model roles.

validation.baseURL: Enter a valid http(s) base URL.
validation.permission: Access to this API host is needed to connect. Allow it when Chrome asks.

hints.region: Mainland China and international accounts use different endpoints. Edit the base URL if your key is for the other region.
hints.ollama: Ollama blocks extensions by default. Start it with the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and try again.

slots.title: Model roles
slots.description: Choose which model handles each kind of work. You can mix providers freely.
slots.typeModelId: No model list for this connection. Type the model ID.

fast.title: Fast model
fast.description: Cheap, quick work: summaries, extraction, titles and risk checks.

agent.title: Agent model
agent.description: Plans and operates web pages. Needs tool calling. If it can't read images (e.g. DeepSeek), the vision model is used as its eyes.

vision.title: Vision model
vision.description: Looks at screenshots and images for models that can't. Pick a cheap, fast multimodal model.

sites.title: Site access
sites.description: Sites and API hosts this extension may access. Nothing is granted at install time; access is asked for when you first use a site.
sites.policiesDescription: Decide what the agent may do on each site. An entry for example.com also covers its subdomains.
sites.defaultPolicy: Sites without a policy: confirm risky actions. High-risk actions (payments, deletions) always need your approval.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. Replies follow the language you write in.

about.title: About
about.privacy: There is no Browser Helper server. Conversations are stored in this browser, and requests go straight to the providers you configure.
about.keys: API keys are stored in this browser's extension storage and are never sent to web pages.

agent.busy: A task is already running in this conversation. Stop it or wait for it to finish.
agent.driverHint: cdp: real mouse and keyboard input · dom: simulated page events

reason.payment: This looks like a payment or purchase.
reason.destructive: This looks hard to undo (delete, cancel, account or security change).
reason.submit: This submits, sends or saves something.
reason.confirmEach: Your policy for this site asks to confirm every step.

permission.title: Allow access to this site?
permission.body: The agent needs to read and operate {{origin}} to continue.

handoff.captcha: {{site}} is asking for a human check. Solve it in the tab, then continue.
handoff.login: Sign in on {{site}} yourself, then continue.
handoff.verification: Enter the verification code on {{site}}, then continue.
handoff.other: Finish this step on {{site}}, then continue.
handoff.autoResume: The task continues by itself once the check is gone.

overlay.running: Browser Helper is working in this tab

paused.user: Paused. Resume when you are ready.
paused.interference: Paused because you used the page. Resume when you are done.
paused.debuggerDetached: Paused: the debugging bar was closed. Resume to continue with simulated events.

waiting.approval: Waiting for your approval in the side panel
waiting.question: The agent has a question for you in the side panel
waiting.handoff: Your turn: finish this step, then click Continue
waiting.permission: Waiting for site access in the side panel

agent.maxStepsSummary: I stopped after {{count}} steps without finishing. Review the steps above, then give me a narrower task or raise the step limit in settings.

agentSettings.title: Agent
agentSettings.description: How the agent operates web pages for you.

agentSettings.notificationsHint: Chrome notifications for CAPTCHAs, sign-ins and approvals.
